name: Isabel Park
bio: Isabel helps colleagues start well and understand how work fits around their lives. She keeps people policies readable and follows up when a situation needs an individual conversation.
responsibilities: Onboarding, first-week questions, manager introductions, and the people handbook.
Time off, leave balances, and questions about local employment arrangements.
Temporary work from another country and home-office equipment budgets. Request country approval at least ten working days ahead; the policy limit is 20 working days per calendar year.
